mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.place_id AS placeId, p.name AS placeName, r.content AS content, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM review r INNER JOIN place p ON p.place_id = r.place_id WHERE r.created_at >= #{startAt} AND r.created_at < #{endAt} AND r.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND r.content IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(r.content) != '' ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.review_id ASC
